name: doaw-server
_comment: Exact versions, not ranges, matched to what the droplet resolved.
This is not superstition: ethers stamps its own version into the text of
its errors, and server/index.js returns that text in the 404 body for an
invalid token id. A floating ^5.7.0 picked up 5.8.0 and changed a
puppeteer 1.20.0 is pinned because it is the renderer, not a dev tool. It
bundles Chromium revision linux-686378 (2019), which is the browser that
drew all 288 published GIFs; webgif screenshots that browser frame by
frame. A newer Chromium would render the artwork differently.
The `webgif` script is required, not convenience: listen/render.js spawns
`yarn webgif -u ... -o ...`, so the script name is effectively an API.
